annotations.text: Everything drawn exists on character.list today — name, handle, avatar, starred, lastChattedAt, createdAt, elevatorPitch, the recent / starred / newest sorts — plus two the owner ruled onto the wire (#865): the chat count on each face, and a closed source (shipped · imported · made here) that names the fresh-install shelf.
